verses.1: And let seven women be with one man on that day, so that they may say, “Let us eat and wear our clothes.” But only your name should be written upon us, so that we may be saved from disgrace.
verses.2: On that day, the Lord will shine upon Israel, bringing prosperity and abundance to the land. It will be a time of glory and honor for the people of Israel.
verses.3: And those who remained in Zion and those who went to Jerusalem, it shall be said to them by all that is written: “May you live in Jerusalem.”
verses.4: If I wash away the blood of the children of Zion and the blood of Jerusalem, then I will do it with the spirit of judgment and with the spirit of vengeance.
verses.5: And Jehovah created all the mountains of Zion, as well as the clouds that cover them during the day. He also created fire that burns at night, so that everything becomes bright and beautiful.
verses.6: And it will be a shadow from the destruction, and a refuge from the torrents and from the storms.
